svg.title: How a Point Track Becomes a Token
svg.desc: Track the same point over sixteen frames, describe each frame using current position, past offset, time and validity, join the frames in time order, and use a shared MLP to obtain one learned track token. Apply the encoder independently to every point.

g.text: How a Point Track Becomes a Token
Track MLP: one small network, reused for every point
Pack the frames in time order
Repeat independently for every tracked point
Schematic point paths and token values. The MLP encodes each history; ACT fusion uses the resulting tokens.
